impact.text: the limit of 10 asset/vault pairs could lead to the protocol being unable to accommodate new assets, where it could otherwise have done so by retiring other assets.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered for an asset by the share token owner, and only one vault per asset is permitted.

intent_sources.text: The protocol should be able to accommodate new assets by retiring other assets rather than being blocked by the 10 asset/vault pair limit.
